text:
Leo T: Heads up — discovered missing decision_log entries for requests carrying header `X-Use-Alt` in canary region. Repro below.
Anika S: repro steps?
Leo T: curl -v -H "X-Use-Alt: true" https://api.redwood.io/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' => 200, response ok but no decision_log row for the route matcher.
Maya R: did you check sampling? maybe that route is 1% sample.
Leo T: sampling config shows normal rates for that route (0.1). I traced one request by trace_id and got nothing.
RoutingBot: [alert] DecisionLogSampler: request_id=abcd1234 sample=false reason="over-sampled-by-header-filter"
Samir P: quick theory: header normalization/override happens after the sampler in the current pipeline, so header-driven shadow routes can bypass decision logging.
Anika S: that order would be surprising — sampler should run after we know the route. Otherwise we lose visibility for header-based routing.
Maya R: also seen with header case variants (`x-use-alt` vs `X-Use-Alt`) — normalization inconsistent.
Leo T: snippet from request inspector shows pipeline order: \n```
pipeline:
  - ingress-normalize-headers
  - sampler(check-tokens)
  - route-eval
  - decision-log
```
Samir P: Proposed changes: either move sampler to after route-eval OR let sampler consult route-eval output when header overrides create shadow routes.
Anika S: and add a metric `decision_log.skipped.reason` with tag `header_override` so we can detect spikes.
Maya R: temp dashboard query: `sum(decision_log_skipped{reason="header_override"}) by (route)` — would show exact affected routes.
Leo T: I'll flip a canary patch to run sampler post-route for a small subset and run e2e tests. @Samir can you own the metric/alert? :pray:
Samir P: on it. Creating feature flag `sampling.order.post_route` and will rollout at 1%. I'll also emit `sampling.order.latency_impact` gauge.
RoutingBot: Deploy started: canary/sampler-reorder v2 -> 1%
Anika S: caution — early sampler reduces downstream load. We need latency and cpu delta before wider rollout.
Leo T: agreed. Plan: collect p50/p95/p99, error rates, and decision_log coverage for 24h. Posting results here once ready.
Maya R: adding action item to routing playbook: "verify sampler placement when header overrides are present".
Console: Created ticket PLAT-1429: Investigate decision_log loss for header-overridden routes.
Leo T: thanks all. Will update after canary metrics.
